verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no page documenting a path for a non-resident individual founder: nothing on eligibility, acceptable foreign IDs or identifiers, or extra steps. The "Register a Foreign (Non-WA) Business" items cover out-of-state entities qualifying in Washington, which is a different capability from guidance for a foreign individual, so it earns no credit. The axis applies to a state business-registration service, so the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a foreign founder, the service documents a path for a non-resident to complete this task — eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, and any extra steps stated on its own pages
